dog.description_text:
Meet Snickers! 🐾

Snickers is a 1-year-old, 8-lb bundle of happiness, curiosity, and personality who made his way to NYC from our West Coast rescue partner in Tijuana, Mexico!

This little guy has adjusted beautifully to life in his foster home, where he shares his space with two cats and another dog. Snickers is incredibly friendly and social, and loves playing with other dogs both indoors and outdoors. Whether he's playfully teasing his canine friends or racing around with them, he's always ready for some fun!

Snickers may be tiny, but he has a BIG personality! He's appointed himself the official household watchdog, always alert to new sounds and visitors and happy to announce their arrival with a bark. Despite his tough-guy attitude, he's a total sweetheart who adores giving kisses, cuddling, and sleeping snuggled up close to his humans. He's also a devoted little shadow who will happily follow you everywhere, especially if chicken or veggies are involved!

This smart cookie is doing wonderfully with his potty training! He happily does his business outside during walks, but also knows how to reliably use wee-wee pads when left home alone. He's also quite the independent little adventurer, confidently navigating stairs, hopping on and off furniture, and making his way up and down three flights of stairs without assistance.

Snickers recently underwent cherry eye repair surgery and is getting stronger every day. He's proven to be a resilient, adaptable little guy who takes new experiences in stride.

With his playful spirit, affectionate nature, and larger-than-life personality, Snickers is sure to bring endless entertainment, love, and laughter to his forever home. ❤️

Vaccinated for rabies, DHPP, and bordetella, microchipped and neutered. Heartworm negative and current on flea, tick, and heartworm prevention.

To apply for Snickers, visit our website (www.waggytailrescue.org) for an adoption application. It is important to fill out an application as soon as possible for consideration, and we require a complete application for you to meet an animal. We are currently unable to respond to general email inquiries as an all-volunteer run rescue. If the dog is on our website, they are still available.

Waggytail Rescue CANNOT guarantee the exact age of any adoptable dog, or final size of any of our adoptable puppies. We rely on the information provided to us by veterinarians, shelters, owner surrenders and other circumstances bringing the dog into our rescue.

Adoptions: adopt@waggytailrescue.org
